tasks.label: Configure Continue AI
tasks.command:
mkdir -p ~/.continue && cat << 'EOF' > ~/.continue/config.yaml
models:
  - title: In-Cluster vLLM Coder
    provider: openai
    model: vllm-cpu
    apiBase: http://vllm-service.vllm-cpu.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1
tabAutocompleteModel:
  title: In-Cluster vLLM Autocomplete
  provider: openai
  model: vllm-cpu
  apiBase: http://vllm-service.vllm-cpu.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1
allowAnonymousTelemetry: false
EOF
